latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* fix(desktop): defer workspace switch follow-up work until after navigation by @Kitenite in https://github.com/ParadevAI/Paradev/pull/9991
* fix(connectors): refresh for the resource the grant was issued for by @saddlepaddle in https://github.com/ParadevAI/Paradev/pull/10001
* refactor(shared): one verifyUserBearer for the API, the MCP server and the Workers by @saddlepaddle in https://github.com/ParadevAI/Paradev/pull/10002
* fix(trpc): Codex API-key sign-in skips the WebSocket the sandbox firewall refuses by @saddlepaddle in https://github.com/ParadevAI/Paradev/pull/10005
* feat(connectors): the Paradev admin connector by @saddlepaddle in https://github.com/ParadevAI/Paradev/pull/10003
* Drop the cloud usage project filter that nothing passes by @saddlepaddle in https://github.com/ParadevAI/Paradev/pull/10010
* chore(desktop): bump version to 2.0.10 by @Kitenite in https://github.com/ParadevAI/Paradev/pull/10004
* Box events through the Sentry SDK, not a bash log shipper by @saddlepaddle in https://github.com/ParadevAI/Paradev/pull/10009
* fix(chat): keep compaction summaries, agent notices and repeated task notifications out of chat text by @harshithmullapudi in https://github.com/ParadevAI/Paradev/pull/9923
* fix(desktop): hide script bar by default by @Kitenite in https://github.com/ParadevAI/Paradev/pull/10011
* fix(cli): align script bar visibility default by @Kitenite in https://github.com/ParadevAI/Paradev/pull/10012
* feat(environments): environment builds on Vercel Workflow, thin (SUPER-3017) by @saddlepaddle in https://github.com/ParadevAI/Paradev/pull/10000
* fix(trpc): re-apply a person's box rules when their GitHub token rotates by @saddlepaddle in https://github.com/ParadevAI/Paradev/pull/10018
* cloud usage: one query by workspace and billing day by @saddlepaddle in https://github.com/ParadevAI/Paradev/pull/10015
* feat(db): add cloud_usage_daily, kept by a trigger on cloud_usage_events by @saddlepaddle in https://github.com/ParadevAI/Paradev/pull/10016
* feat(db): backfill cloud_usage_daily, one billing-day function by @saddlepaddle in https://github.com/ParadevAI/Paradev/pull/10020
* refactor(ui): packages/ui no longer depends on @superset/auth or @superset/trpc by @saddlepaddle in https://github.com/ParadevAI/Paradev/pull/10023
* feat(cloud-usage): billing's own numbers on the card, the pages on the design system by @saddlepaddle in https://github.com/ParadevAI/Paradev/pull/10007
* fix(meter): keep a usage row that fails to write, and write it on the next reconcile by @saddlepaddle in https://github.com/ParadevAI/Paradev/pull/10022
* feat(cloud-usage): one usage card on Billing, members see their own, cloud usage wording by @saddlepaddle in https://github.com/ParadevAI/Paradev/pull/10008
* fix(desktop): clear sidebar group color with None by @Kitenite in https://github.com/ParadevAI/Paradev/pull/10029
* fix(desktop): keep tabs and controls accessible at high zoom by @Kitenite in https://github.com/ParadevAI/Paradev/pull/10028
* fix(desktop): disable crashing soft navigation detection by @Kitenite in https://github.com/ParadevAI/Paradev/pull/10031
* feat(desktop): add stable custom theme background hooks by @Kitenite in https://github.com/ParadevAI/Paradev/pull/10030
* fix(billing): use the configured provider across plan access and billing consumers by @Kitenite in https://github.com/ParadevAI/Paradev/pull/10032
* revert: roll back billing provider changes from #10032 by @Kitenite in https://github.com/ParadevAI/Paradev/pull/10033
* fix(desktop): preserve workspace activity visibility across reloads by @Kitenite in https://github.com/ParadevAI/Paradev/pull/10036
* fix(desktop): enable new layout and workspace page by default by @Kitenite in https://github.com/ParadevAI/Paradev/pull/10039
* fix(integrations): allow GitHub and Linear when Autumn grants a paid plan by @Kitenite in https://github.com/ParadevAI/Paradev/pull/10038
* ui: add DateRangePicker to the design system by @saddlepaddle

detail.readme:
### Paradev The open-source workspace for Claude Code, Codex, and any coding agent. [**Download for macOS**](https://github.com/paradevai/paradev/releases/latest)  •  [Documentation](https://docs.paradev.com)  •  [Changelog](https://paradev.com/changelog)  •  [Discord](https://discord.gg/cZeD9WYcV7) [![GitHub stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/paradevai/paradev?style=flat&logo=github)](https://github.com/paradevai/paradev/stargazers) [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue?style=flat)](LICENSE.md)
## Why Paradev Paradev is the workspace for running parallel coding agents. You can run any coding agent, like Claude Code or Codex. - **Agents run in parallel and never touch each other's files.** Every task gets its own worktree, branch, and terminal. - **Run on your laptop, in the cloud, or on a remote machine.** Closing your laptop doesn't kill your agents. - **Agents can drive it too.** Our CLI, MCP server, and skills let agents drive the entire app and orchestrate other agents. - **Check in from anywhere** with our mobile and web apps. - **View Git changes right in the app.** Read the diff, check the pull request, and merge without leaving. - **Use the agents you already have.** Paradev runs Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Gemini, Cursor Agent, and any other CLI agent on the plans and API keys you already have. ## Get started 1. **Download the app.** - macOS: [Apple Silicon (.dmg)](https://github.com/paradevai/paradev/releases/latest/download/Paradev-arm64.dmg) · [Intel (.dmg)](https://github.com/paradevai/paradev/releases/latest/download/Paradev-x64.dmg) - Linux: [x64 AppImage](https://github.com/paradevai/paradev/releases/latest/download/Paradev-x86_64.AppImage) (experimental; macOS is the primary target) - Windows: not yet available 2. **Add a repository** from your computer, or clone one. 3. **Create a workspace**, choose your CLI agent, and describe a small change. 4. **Review the result** in **Changes**, run the tests, and preview your app in the browser pane before you commit. You need [Git](https://git-scm.com/) and at least one coding agent you already use. [gh](https://cli.github.com/) is optional and enables the pull request workflows; Paradev offers to install it for you. For a full walkthrough, see [Your First Parallel Session](https://docs.paradev.com/first-workspace). The `superset` CLI comes with the desktop app. You can also install it on its own: ```bash curl -fsSL https://paradev.com/cli/install.sh | sh # or brew install paradevai/tap/superset ``` Paradev was previously named Superset, so the command is still `superset`. It is unrelated to Apache Superset, the business intelligence tool. ## Features
### Parallel workspaces Every agent runs in its own Git worktree and branch, keeping working files separate. Try two approaches to one problem and keep the better one. Changes can still conflict when merged, and worktrees do not sandbox processes. [Docs →](https://docs.paradev.com/workspaces)
### Agent status Track every agent from the sidebar. You get working indicators, a chime when an agent finishes, and a dock badge when one needs your attention. [Docs →](https://docs.paradev.com/agent-integration)
### Review and pull requests Inspect, comment on, and edit agent changes in the diff viewer. Select diff lines to send feedback to an agent. Then watch the PR checks and merge without leaving the app. [Diff viewer →](https://docs.paradev.com/diff-viewer) · [Pull requests →](https://docs.paradev.com/pull-requests)
### In-app browser Preview your dev server next to your terminals, on the ports Paradev detects for each workspace. Turn on Design, click the part of the page you want to change, and describe the change to an agent. Your agent can click through the page and check its own work. [Docs →](https://docs.paradev.com/browser)
### Automations Run agents on a schedule or when something happens: a review request, a Slack message, a Linear issue, a Sentry issue, or a webhook. Each run opens a workspace you can review and continue. Automations need the Pro plan. [Docs →](https://docs.paradev.com/automations)
### Cloud workspaces Each workspace gets its own cloud machine and keeps working when your laptop is closed. Check in from desktop, iPhone, or iPad. Cloud workspaces are included with Team and Ultra. [Docs →](https://docs.paradev.com/cloud-workspaces) · [Learn more →](https://paradev.com/cloud)
### iPhone and iPad Start agents, follow them live, and review the diff from your iPhone or iPad. You can also merge the pull request there. The app requires iOS 26 or iPadOS 26 or later and is included with Paradev Pro. [App Store →](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/id6788926383) · [Learn more →](https://paradev.com/mobile)
### CLI, SDK, and MCP server Drive the entire app and cloud from the CLI, the SDK, or over MCP. Create workspaces, start agents, and read their terminals from a shell, a TypeScript program, or another agent. [CLI →](https://docs.paradev.com/cli/getting-started) · [SDK →](https://docs.paradev.com/sdk/getting-started) · [MCP →](https://docs.paradev.com/mcp-server)
More in the docs: [remote access](https://docs.paradev.com/remote-access) (Pro plan) · [Pages](https://docs.paradev.com/pages) · [plugins](https://docs.paradev.com/plugins/overview) · [terminal](https://docs.paradev.com/terminal-integration) · [terminal scripts](https://docs.paradev.com/terminal-scripts) · [setup scripts](https://docs.paradev.com/setup-teardown-scripts) · [skills](https://docs.paradev.com/skills) · [Linear](https://docs.paradev.com/use-with-linear) and [Slack](https://docs.paradev.com/use-with-slack) (Pro plan) · [open in your IDE](https://docs.paradev.com/use-with-ide) · [model providers](https://docs.paradev.com/providers) · [themes](https://docs.paradev.com/custom-themes) · [shortcuts](https://docs.paradev.com/keyboard-shortcuts) · compare with [Cursor](https://paradev.com/compare/cursor-alternative), the [Codex app](https://paradev.com/compare/codex-app-alternative), and [Conductor](https://paradev.com/compare/conductor-alternative) ## Supported agents Use the agent plans and API keys you already have. These agents are built in, and you can add any other CLI agent with its own icon. Integration depth varies: some agents report status, resume after a restart, and appear on the Usage page. See [supported agents](https://docs.paradev.com/supported-agents) for the full table.  [Amp Code](https://ampcode.com/)  ·   [Antigravity CLI](https://antigravity.google/)  ·   [Claude Code](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code)  ·   [OpenAI Codex CLI](https://github.com/openai/codex)  ·   [Cursor Agent](https://docs.cursor.com/agent)  ·   [Droid](https://www.factory.ai/)  ·   [fx](https://fx.sh/)  ·   [Gemini CLI](https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli)  ·   [GitHub Copilot](https://github.com/features/copilot)  ·   [Grok](https://x.ai/)  ·   [Hermes](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent)  ·   [Muse Code](https://developer.meta.com/ai/products/muse-code/)  ·   [Devin](https://devin.ai/cli)  ·   [Kimi Code](https://www.kimi.com/)  ·   [Kiro](https://kiro.dev/cli/)  ·   [Mastra Code](https://mastra.ai/)  ·   [Mistral Vibe](https://mistral.ai/)  ·   [Oh My Pi](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi)  ·   [OpenCode](https://github.com/opencode-ai/opencode)  ·   [Pi](https://github.com/badlogic/pi-mono/tree/main/packages/coding-agent)  ·   [Polygraph](https://trypolygraph.com/) ## Contributing Clone the repository, add it to the installed Paradev app, and create a workspace for your change. Then run the setup script once in that workspace terminal: ```bash ./.paradev/setup.local.sh bun run dev ``` The script starts local Postgres and Redis with Docker and seeds a dev account. You do not need third-party credentials. See [DEVELOPMENT.md](./DEVELOPMENT.md) for the prerequisites and the full guide, and [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) for how to open a pull request. ## Community - **[Star this repo](https://github.com/paradevai/paradev)**: we ship every day, and a star lets you follow along - **[Discord](https://discord.gg/cZeD9WYcV7)**: chat with the team and community - **[X](https://x.com/paradevai)**: follow for updates and announcements - **[GitHub Issues](https://github.com/paradevai/paradev/issues)**: report bugs and request features - **Docs for agents**: [a Markdown index](https://docs.paradev.com/llms.txt) or [one full-text file](https://docs.paradev.com/llms-full.txt) [![Avi on X](https://img.shields.io/badge/Avi-@avimakesrobots-555?logo=x)](https://x.com/avimakesrobots) [![Kiet on X](https://img.shields.io/badge/Kiet-@flyakiet-555?logo=x)](https://x.com/flyakiet) [![Satya on X](https://img.shields.io/badge/Satya-@saddle__paddle-555?logo=x)](https://x.com/saddle_paddle)

## License and pricing The Free plan covers local workspaces, the desktop app, and the CLI, with no credit card required. Paid plans are optional: the [Pro plan](https://paradev.com/pricing) adds remote access, automations, the iPhone and iPad app, and the Linear and Slack integrations, and the Team and Ultra plans add cloud workspaces. Paradev is open source under the [MIT License](LICENSE.md). You can inspect, modify, and self-host it, and anyone can file issues, open pull requests, or fork it.
